name: Ford - Chicago Assembly Plant, Chicago IL

classification.entryLanesNote: two inbound lanes at the Torrence Ave guarded gate

fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded truck gate confirmed mid-property on Torrence Ave (~41.6615, -87.5593). 2024 Street View shows a tan single-story guard house with multi-side windows at the perimeter fence line, bollards/lane-control structures, directional signage ('ALL INBOUND TRAFFIC', 'VISITOR PARKING'), and trucks staged in the apron.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed - small staffed booth (1-2 vehicle footprint, Ford-branded) set beside the gate lane, distinct from the main building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron with multiple usable lane widths; room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach between Torrence Ave and the docks/fence; easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound supplier/sequencing docks (LEAR seat plant + JIT yard) on the south/SE; finished-vehicle outbound handled separately via rail and the river-side marshalling lots - distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large interconnected campus - main sawtooth assembly building plus a body shop, paint, the LEAR supplier building, water-treatment plant, and a river-side marshalling/staging lot.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail tracks run the SW property edge with spurs entering the plant - historic and active rail service.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated south trailer-storage yard packed with parked drop trailers (Innovative Logistics Group and others), separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~45 across the supplier/JIT dock banks visible in z19-20 imagery; full plant has additional internal docks not all visible from overhead - low confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale identified in imagery; left false.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single combined entry/exit gate group; outbound lane count inferred.
